name: Merchant Ship Deck
author: voodoo573
description: The top deck of a single-masted trading ship at sea: aft cabin roof, cargo hatch, masts, stacked crates and barrels, and small deck guns along both rails. Surrounded by open water. 28 x 14 squares at 64 px per 5-ft square.
summary: Trading ship deck at sea with hatch, cargo and masts.
credits: Original battle map created for the Hearth Community repository by voodoo573 (2026), drawn procedurally with a Python/PIL script; no third-party art used. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
